The Account activity card and the Download my data button are written. I haven't run anything: no tests, lint, app, `pnpm i18n` or bundle step.

**What it does**
- The Account activity card on the profile page shows "Account created" and "Last login". Dates use the user's locale. If the user has no recorded login, it shows "Not available".
- The card also holds the Download my data button. It downloads `formbricks-my-data.json` with name, email, locale, notification settings and organization memberships (organization name and role).
- Only accepted memberships are included. Credentials are never selected.

**How it's built**
- Server actions are legacy here, so the export is a session-only `GET /api/v3/account/data-export`.
- The button uses TanStack Query. I added a `layout.tsx` under `account/settings/profile` to provide the query client, as other route segments do.
- The route handler is `apps/web/app/api/v3/account/data-export/route.ts` and the query is in `apps/web/app/api/v3/account/lib/data-export.ts`.
- I added a unit test, `apps/web/app/api/v3/account/lib/data-export.test.ts`, covering the response shape, the user-id scoping, 401 and 500.
- The client pieces are in `apps/web/app/(app)/workspaces/[workspaceId]/settings/account/profile/` (`components/AccountActivity.tsx`, `components/DownloadMyDataButton.tsx`, `lib/download-my-data.ts`). The card is wired into `account/settings/profile/page.tsx`.

**What you need to run**
- Run `pnpm api:v3:bundle`. I added the endpoint to the OpenAPI source (`docs/api-v3-reference/src/paths/api_v3_account_data-export.yml`, registered in `src/openapi.yml`). The command needed approval, so I didn't run it. Until you do, `docs/api-v3-reference/openapi.yml` is stale and `pnpm api:v3:check` will fail.
- Run `pnpm i18n` to generate the other locales. I only added the new en-US keys, under `workspace.settings.profile`.

I didn't read `docs/agents/pull-requests.md`, because I haven't committed anything.
